part2.question: Describe a natural place in your city that you enjoy visiting

segments.v: I want to talk about West Lake in Hà Nội. It is the biggest lake in my city. It is about twenty minutes from my house. The lake is very big and beautiful. There are many trees, temples and cafés around it. In summer there are lotus flowers. I go there about two times a month, usually at the weekend. I often go with my friends. We ride bikes around the lake and drink coffee. Sometimes I go with my family and we visit Trấn Quốc Pagoda. I enjoy visiting there because it is quiet and the air is fresh. The sunset there is very beautiful. When I feel stressed, I go there to relax. I love this place very much.
